reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-team: the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is **382 seats**.

That number comes from Tobias's post in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing later in the channel changes it. Hollis is a member of #central-team, and a seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to share there. I also checked the shared files Hollis can see, and none of them mention the renewal, so I couldn't confirm the number anywhere else.
